name: Mystic Lover
source: You who live hard in the city, meet the one you like who are impressed. Do you enjoy the passion and beauty of love, or work hard for your thriving career? The workplace experience intertwined with love and the ups and downs of the plot, can you create a different life? This surreal dream is waiting for you to make!
translation: 在城市里辛苦生活的你，会遇见一个让你感动的人。你是享受爱情的激情与美好，还是为事业的蒸蒸日上而努力奋斗？与爱情交织的职场经历和跌宕起伏的剧情，你能创造出不一样的人生吗？这个超现实的梦想正等你来实现！
